decision: Tarek explicitly selected Scoped experimental alpha: require the real full single-file toolchain flow and its safety/proof/native gates; keep omitted features unavailable and the full 32-gate release inventory unchanged.
precedence: This profile changes only the public experimental-alpha acceptance boundary. Revision-5 semantics, implemented-path safety and proof obligations remain controlling. No immutable registry is edited and no WF gate is passed by substitution.

platform.realm: Fresh disposable private owner-controlled local filesystem only; no production-data migration or existing-realm conversion.
platform.coordination: One explicit backend and managed writer/coordinator per trust realm. Separate read-only clients do not acquire effect authority.
platform.core: Static musl Rust executable; Git, Worktrunk, Weft and Omnigraph are separately pinned native dependencies.
platform.native_storage: Independent complete native backup/restore at the same canonical URI. Managed-root adoption at a new URI is unsupported and must refuse rather than rewrite native metadata.
platform.native_namespace_assumption: Keep the canonical native root and every ancestor unchanged throughout ownership. The native engine resolves pathnames; a retained directory descriptor plus repeated identity checks does not contain rename ABA between checks. Non-cooperating namespace mutation is unsupported, observed drift contains the native process, and cleanup failure must retain ownership.
platform.native_uri_profile: The current runtime admits only plain absolute canonical file-URI paths using ASCII letters, digits, slash, dot, underscore and hyphen; other native-root spellings refuse rather than receive unqualified normalization.

backend.name: omnigraph
backend.decision: Exact source candidate is a development unblocker; prefer a supported upstream remedy before public alpha. A matching version string is not matching source provenance.
backend.retired_direction: Dolt-specific alpha expansion remains paused; DINT receipts keep their original supplemental scope.

enabled_scope_required_before_distributi: Explicit new-realm initialization with exact native/tool/schema/query/profile identities and retained immutable policy.
Retained exact input/recipe/candidate/report artifacts with realm/kind/revision-qualified references and bounded integrity-checked reads.
Completed Git-CAS artifact-corpus publication over retained native graph pins; artifact retention is not automatic semantic knowledge admission.
A fixed immutable manually approved reviewed-edit procedure with exact repository/base/Worktrunk binding and a declared completion boundary.
Host replay through the pinned embedded Splicery compiler/kernel; one existing regular singly linked file, content edits only, no target write during preparation.
Actual pinned Weft local-symbolic assessment of exact retained bytes; grounding and effect-authority flags remain false. Incomplete or nonentailed required checks block this procedure's apply.
Separate explicit operator Ed25519 approval over the exact prepared/report/procedure/policy/realm/run/resource/binding/expiry material, with live grant/revocation checks.
Validated immutable EngineeringLedger records selected by conditional heads, full historical-prefix and closure checks, and explicit logical-record/material binding.
Stable principal/realm/run/request mapping to original intent/effect, cross-stream resource reservation, current-generation checks and durable claim before native target IO.
Persisted native stage witness, exactly-once attempted install, file/directory durability observation, durable receipt and original-effect lookup after lost responses.
Unknown-preserving crash/cancellation recovery under owned-child quiescence; exact inode/content/metadata reconciliation, never blind replay or equal-byte confirmation of a foreign inode.
CLI and ordinary bounded stdio methods sharing typed application decisions and immutable prepared views; no RPC-generated operator approval or oversized successful response.
Complete independent restore, clean installation and real multi-process end-to-end adverse-case campaign for the exact distributable artifacts.
disabled_scope: Automatic grounded Weft knowledge or proof-derived edit permission
Arbitrary graph mutation, raw native queries or shell-command effect adapters
File creation, removal, rename, symlink/hardlink targets and unsupported native metadata
Unresolved interactive Splicery handles or client-authoritative candidate bytes
General skill-package ingestion, delegated procedure composition and arbitrary automatic workflows
Cross-repository changes, remote forge/deploy effects, remote synchronization and provider credentials
Autonomous learning/evaluation/promotion and inferred policy widening
Obsidian/plugin publication and general graph browser
Destructive garbage collection, production migration and managed-root relocation
Revision-9 universal per-proposal Lean certificate, external prover and mixed-policy registry activation

qualification_requirements.name: Exact build, source and native dependency admission
qualification_requirements.requires: Source/tool/fixture/profile/archive/member identities, real installed native runtime, private roots, hook/environment control and owned bounded processes; no component-only receipt promoted to runtime admission.

qualification_requirements.name: Canonical identity and bounded references
qualification_requirements.requires: Distinct logical/content identities, exact canonical/signing bytes, realm/kind/revision binding, separate request/citation/ownership generations and actual checked Rust-body proof mappings.

qualification_requirements.name: Retained corpus and completed publication
qualification_requirements.requires: Native graph/commit/epoch/query pin compatibility and complete retained closure before completed Git CAS; failure/recovery preserves the selected release and original operation.

qualification_requirements.name: Validated ledger and conditional ownership
qualification_requirements.requires: Closed historical payload validation, full linked retained prefixes, unique logical-record/material binding, checked sequence/generation arithmetic and compare-and-select heads; an opaque log or caller Boolean is not a ledger validator.

qualification_requirements.name: Run, procedure, Worktrunk and current grants
qualification_requirements.requires: Real exact-base worktree creation, current scope/resource/binding/generation checks, fixed well-typed procedure, least authority, revocation/expiry and conflict-aware run intake.

qualification_requirements.name: Real language-toolchain preparation
qualification_requirements.requires: Actual pinned Weft report and embedded Splicery host replay, exact byte/provenance closure, refusal of incomplete/nonentailed required checks, and no implicit grounding or effect authority.

qualification_requirements.name: Separate explicit authenticated approval
qualification_requirements.requires: Exact closed approval payload/domain, strict strong Ed25519 verification, actual owner identity and live policy/grant/expiry checks; wrong-domain or transplanted signatures refuse.

qualification_requirements.name: Claim, reservation and native materialization
qualification_requirements.requires: Durable original request/effect/intent mapping and cross-stream reservation before IO; full preimage metadata, persisted stage witness, no conflicting mutator and one attempted install.

qualification_requirements.name: Receipt, cancellation and reconciliation
qualification_requirements.requires: Durable receipts; deterministic claim/stage/install/receipt interruption coverage; owned descendants reaped before resource release; original-ID outcome lookup and quiescent exact-inode reconciliation with Unknown preserved.

qualification_requirements.name: Shared CLI and ordinary agent surface
qualification_requirements.requires: Same typed decisions, truthful separately pinned owner capability contract, bounded chunked artifacts and correlated frames, current authority per operation, cancellation/lost-response outcomes and explicit disabled methods.

qualification_requirements.name: Independent complete restoration
qualification_requirements.requires: Original physical roots unavailable; canonical native URIs preserved; exact current and retained histories, ledger/artifact/policy/approval closure and signed bytes survive; no init/apply/re-import substitute.

qualification_requirements.name: Composed safety and proof bridges
qualification_requirements.requires: Preserved E01-E12 assumptions and legacy T01-T22, selected shipping Rust-body Verus proofs, TLC interleavings, TLAPS safety and explicit native/codec/model refinement bridges for every enabled path; tests or differential agreement alone are not refinement.

qualification_requirements.name: Clean installed full-flow acceptance
qualification_requirements.requires: Actual native binaries installed into a fresh private prefix; documented example and custom file exercised end to end, stale/wrong-domain/revoked/ABA/concurrent/uncertain adversarial controls; no mock service, source-checkout or proof-runtime dependency.

qualification_requirements.name: Distribution, licenses and truthful public claims
qualification_requirements.requires: Exact manifest/checksums, complete applicable notices and license inventory, install/upgrade/refusal behavior, source-bound evidence summary and exercised website instructions; private source/playbook/credentials never published.

evidence_policy.rule: Every ALPHA requirement is mandatory for this profile. Disabled paths must be absent or explicitly rejected, not silently exercised without their obligations.
evidence_policy.mapping: Before enabling a path, map its exact production symbols, native assumptions, source/model/caller bridges and adverse scenarios to the applicable R5 V/M/E obligations. A smaller enabled action family narrows coverage, not truth conditions.
evidence_policy.reuse: Retain failed attempts and original scope; reuse only by explicit exact-source/dependency/fixture linkage. A status label, passing unit suite or old component receipt is not admission.
evidence_policy.release: An alpha receipt may qualify only this profile and exact artifacts. Full WF00-WF31, V/M and scenario entries retain their original statuses; WF31 remains final full composed aggregation.
